name: Rosie
role: Vietnamese woman who worked the door at the club
summary: One of the Vietnamese girls at the club, who worked at the door. Larry remembers her by name — Rosie — and knows one more thing about her: she made it to America. There are no photographs of her in the collection.
larrysRecollection: Rosie, one of Vietnamese girls at the club who worked at the door.  She made it to America. Don't have pictures of her. (Tell a Story comment, 2026-08-15)
